observations: Large white plastic IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tank.
The tank is fitted with a metal cage (also known as a 'basket') for structural support.
A black lid is visible on the top of the tank.
A hand is holding a metal bar of the cage in the foreground.
The tank is located in an outdoor storage yard with other similar tanks in the background.
Watermark 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Ibc tank for storage of water or any liquid very strong and durable
claims.evidence: The design of the tank and cage is standard for industrial bulk storage.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tank may be empty or contain a corrosive/contaminated liquid.
risks.proof: A photo of the tank with a clear water level or a label showing the contents.

risks.risk: The tank may be leaking or have structural damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the tank being filled and the water level rising.

risks.risk: The tank may be expired or have a compromised liner.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label showing the production date and material specifications.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's label on the side of the tank showing the capacity and material.
Photo of the tank with water to confirm it is not empty.
Video of the tank being filled to check for leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
